objective: PPTX fidelity against LibreOffice, with office2pdf as a secondary baseline
acceptance: All 627 pinned cases retained, including expected normal errors
No new crashes, timeouts, missing text, page count changes or unexplained pixel regressions
All-page raster comparisons where page geometry is compatible; incompatible geometry reported explicitly
Targeted semantic assertions and old-binary negative controls for each supported feature

loop.approval: Reusable script prefix saved by environment and exercised successfully
loop.isolation: bwrap, no network, pinned fixtures/fonts, 4 GiB address space, 256 MiB output, timeout, separate fresh output directory
iteration: Compact byte-identical completed candidates under exclusive lock; preserve all paths and bytes
Run all four shards and visual audit
Investigate every regression rather than average it away
loop.resume: --resume loop-TIMESTAMP reuses the immutable candidate and completed conversions
loop.reuse_build: --reuse-build loop-TIMESTAMP evaluates a previously tested immutable executable; provenance explicitly distinguishes it from the current workspace
